plan.title: Auto title consistency across buyer and vendor views

steps.note: Start the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested product and quantity while preserving the automatic title.
Set the delivery location that should be reflected in the generated title.
Verify the selected delivery location is present in the pricing sheet.
Invite one available QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the event so its generated title is available on the project and portal.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify the generated title on the published project page.
Return to the buyer's events list after publishing.
Verify the Live events list rendered successfully.
View the Live list where the newly published event should appear.
Search by this plan's own generated title and verify the event is listed.
Open the invited QA vendor's portal in the separate vendor session.
Open this event from the vendor portal event list, confirming the vendor can access it.
Verify the same generated title on the vendor portal event view.
